title: Migrate per-language detectors onto tree-sitter
description:
Move the scanner's per-language detectors from line-based text matching onto the tree-sitter engine, one language at a time. Follows decision 2 of the parent initiative.

## Context

The Python, PHP, Go, and JVM analyzers work on comment-stripped text line by line. TypeScript uses the TypeScript compiler API. Once the analysis engine exists, detectors can run on the same trees, and new languages (Ruby, Rust, Lua, Perl, Haskell) come from query packs rather than new analyzers.

## Scope

- Per language: port detectors to tree-sitter captures, keeping existing detector rules and ids.
- Keep the TypeScript compiler only where it adds type information, as an optional enrichment.

## Done when

- Each ported language shows no regression on the four-layer scorecard across the corpus.

Lower priority. Starts after the analysis epics land.
